title: Digital Design for Arts Administrators I
description: Effective visual communication has become vital for businesses in today’s global market. AAD 250: Digital Design for Arts Administrations I will explore the powerful graphic and visual design programs of Adobe Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator and iMovie. Students will develop an ‘eye’ for design through the exploration of advanced design software, advanced design elements, and peer critiques. Students will demonstrate basic design skills through design projects for both print and the web.
prerequisites: Enrollment limited to AAD pre-majors prior to add/drop
